evidence_quotes: Alle brannvesenene i regionen har nå gått sammen om en felles veileder.
Den nye fellesveilederen for Agder er laget for å komplettere og utdype disse kravene
data.reason: Brannvesenet Sør IKS has announced the publication of a new regional guide for fire safety and building requirements in Agder, which they developed in collaboration with other fire departments.
